scheme_name: West Bengal Textile Incentive Scheme: Subsidy for Water conservation/ Environment Compliance
other_conditions: Unit should have started production on or after 1st April 2022
Units may be in private sector, co‑operative sector, joint sector, or owned/managed by the State Government
Shall not be applicable to industrial units/enterprises
Project must be approved and sanctioned by a Central Financial Institution, Commercial Bank or State Financial Institution
Unit must hold a Registration Certificate, Date of Commencement Certificate and Eligibility Certificate issued by the Directorate of Textiles
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of 25% of eligible expenditure up to ₹1.5 crore; for clusters of at least 5 units with a minimum investment of ₹200 crore, a Common Effluent Treatment Plant will be set up by the state.
